sourceFacts.fact: A classic target lesion has three concentric colour zones.
The centre is dusky, the middle zone paler and the peripheral margin erythematous.
Real lesions vary and target-like appearances can have different causes.

labels: Colour model, not a diagnostic skin image

checks: Exactly three visible colour regions ordered dusky centre→pale middle→red outer.
Each label leader terminates within the correct zone.
Flat paper circle, no tissue layers, clinical skin or eye resemblance.
